description: The caller's own gift ideas, for whoever drew them.

participantEmail.description: The caller's email address. Overwritten with the signed-in address, so naming somebody else does nothing.

hatId.description: The gift exchange, which the caller must be taking part in.

ideas.description: What the caller wrote. Judged by the same content rules as the share page in an email; a refusal is a 422 saying why.

holdUntilAsked.description: Keep them until whoever drew the caller asks for gift ideas, rather than sending them now.
